All products are appropriate for the stated patient unless an option says otherwise. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

choices.text: A noncertified fully licensed technician uses only hours worked as a trainee to satisfy the post-licensure 500-hour pathway.
A technician trainee gives a vaccination after completing the technician vaccine course while still holding only trainee status.
A provider honors a patient’s MIIS data-sharing objection while continuing required reporting to the Department.
A pharmacy gives the applicable VIS only with the receipt after vaccination is finished.

choice_analysis.A: 선택하지 않을 항목. 경험 경로는 full PT licensure 이후 시간이다. PTT 시간과 구별한다. 올바른 처리: A noncertified fully licensed technician counts at least 500 hours worked after full technician licensure toward the experience pathway.
choice_analysis.B: 선택하지 않을 항목. 주 정책은 full Pharmacy Technician license 를 전제로 하고 PTT 를 포함하지 않는다. 올바른 처리: A technician trainee assists with permitted non-injection tasks but does not give vaccinations under the state policy.

A pharmacy keeps only the insurance claim and omits the administration-specific patient and product records.
A pharmacist uses a multidose supply as the basis for bypassing the circular’s single-dose packaging requirement.
